text: {"grades": [{"area": "contact", "level": "flag", "reason": "Strangers can message or voice chat with the child, and no cited setting shuts that door.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_13ef933f57ca74df", "f_d42c00ffd7a27c3e", "f_e42142508f0e6c8a"]}, {"area": "money", "level": "flag", "reason": "The title pushes purchases at children: loot boxes, pay-to-win pressure, subscription traps, or purchases a child can complete without a parent.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_1f8ad057919885d2", "f_617ef30b88662b85", "f_8e63e88f4f3ed463"]}, {"area": "data", "level": "flag", "reason": "Children's data is collected and used in ways a parent cannot control: ad tracking aimed at children, third-party sharing or selling, or no way to delete what was collected.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_1e242dc4bf501739", "f_b4d5eaf5ea37a5fb", "f_3863f822c43eb156"]}, {"area": "age_gating", "level": "flag", "reason": "The age gate fails in practice: a first-hand report that a child ended up on the wrong side of it, a child far under the stated age getting in, a check that accepts any birth date, or a check that places a child at the wrong age.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_3832ce49d8ba54a2", "f_3e1e4d584522e5a9", "f_6d5f412b40fb55a0"]}, {"area": "content", "level": "flag", "reason": "Parents or reviewers report children actually meeting unsuitable material on this title: sexual content, realistic violence, horror, harassment or self-harm.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_3dc06be183d151be", "f_27cffc324c551e87", "f_38becf1fa1eeaaaf"]}, {"area": "developer_record", "level": "flag", "reason": "This title's developer has a record of enforcement over how it treats children or their data: fines, data breaches, lawsuits or regulatory actions naming this developer.", "setting": "", "findings": ["f_936fa34c97679429", "f_def610c472adb7ff", "f_e6456ac7986e1e75"]}]}
